answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital to participate in network consensus. Unlike a fleeting zephyr, this economic commitment imposes a tangible cost: an attacker must acquire significant, umber-colored collateral to influence the ledger. Just as the root structure of a cedar anchors a tree against storms, bonded stakes anchor identity to asset scarcity, ensuring that spinning up infinite fake agents becomes prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
